headline.text: Revenue growth is steady: guided flat
Management wording (confident vs cautious cues, -1..+1): prepared +0.64, qa +1.00

trajectory.name: Total company

guided.text: Retained liability exposures grew 3% year-over-year at the low end of our 2026 outlook range, consistent with our expectation that growth would build over the year.

signals.speaker: Michel Khalaf
signals.sentence: This was an outstanding quarter and another clear demonstration of how our New Frontier strategy is working as intended and how repeatable our model is built on a powerful recurring revenue base and the flexibility to invest where we see the most compelling global risk-adjusted opportunities.

signals.speaker: Michel Khalaf
signals.sentence: The other is capital-driven, where our retirement and spread-based businesses leverage our origination, investment and risk management capabilities to put our balance sheet to work at attractive risk-adjusted returns.

signals.speaker: Michel Khalaf
signals.sentence: Our capital-driven businesses originate assets that are managed by MetLife Investment Management, supporting the growth of our asset management platform and expanding our capital-light earnings over time.

signals.speaker: Michel Khalaf
signals.sentence: Adjusted earnings increased 15% from the prior year period.

signals.speaker: Michel Khalaf
signals.sentence: Adjusted earnings per share increased 20%, faster than earnings growth, reflecting our measured and consistent approach to capital management.

signals.speaker: Michel Khalaf
signals.sentence: Adjusted premiums, fees and other revenues, excluding pension risk transfers, increased 5% year-over-year.

signals.speaker: Michel Khalaf
signals.sentence: Sales rose 7%, led by strong growth across our international businesses.

signals.speaker: Michel Khalaf
signals.sentence: Variable investment income totaled $231 million pretax and was higher than the prior year period.

signals.speaker: Michel Khalaf
signals.sentence: We achieved this despite approximately 50 basis points of impact from the addition of PineBridge Investments, a fee-based business with a structurally higher expense profile.

signals.speaker: Michel Khalaf
signals.sentence: Even as we integrate that business, we remain on target through rigorous expense management and productivity gains from AI and other technologies.

signals.speaker: Michel Khalaf
signals.sentence: To that point, AI is becoming a structural advantage for MetLife and our scale sets us apart.

signals.speaker: Michel Khalaf
signals.sentence: Over time, we expect that to be a meaningful and durable tailwind to both growth and productivity while creating an even more seamless experience for our customers.

signals.speaker: Michel Khalaf
signals.sentence: Critically, we carefully monitor our AI-related investments and expenses, including model usage and token costs.

signals.speaker: Michel Khalaf
signals.sentence: They're held to the same return standards we have for any other investments we make or expenses we have.

signals.speaker: Michel Khalaf
signals.sentence: And the gains we're achieving in growth, productivity and customer service, which is evident in our direct expense ratio, far exceed the costs.

signals.speaker: Michel Khalaf
signals.sentence: And above all, governance and risk oversight remains central to how we deploy AI, consistent with the trust our customers place in MetLife.

signals.speaker: Michel Khalaf
signals.sentence: The segment generated adjusted earnings of $503 million, up 25% year-over-year.

signals.speaker: Michel Khalaf
signals.sentence: Year-to-date sales are up 9% with regional business advancing 11% led by the under-1,000 employee market.

signals.speaker: Michel Khalaf
signals.sentence: We saw double-digit sales gains year-to-date in disability and voluntary products with particular strength in A&H. These results demonstrate the quality of this flagship franchise.

signals.speaker: Michel Khalaf
signals.sentence: Our scale, broad product set and long-standing customer relationships set us apart and position us well to meet the evolving needs of employers and employees, while delivering responsible growth over time.

signals.speaker: Michel Khalaf
signals.sentence: Moving to Retirement and Income Solutions, or RIS, we reported adjusted earnings of $377 million, up 2% from a year ago.

signals.speaker: Michel Khalaf
signals.sentence: Adjusted PFOs, excluding pension risk transfers, increased 19%, driven primarily by U.K. longevity reinsurance and structured settlement sales.

signals.speaker: Michel Khalaf
signals.sentence: And MetLife has the origination capabilities, investment expertise and product breadth to serve that demand across key global markets.

signals.speaker: Michel Khalaf
signals.sentence: This breadth affords MetLife the capacity to be selective in deploying capital, choosing to pursue only the highest returning risk-adjusted opportunities.

signals.speaker: Michel Khalaf
signals.sentence: Adjusted earnings of $420 million increased 21% on a reported basis and 25% on a constant currency basis.

signals.speaker: Michel Khalaf
signals.sentence: Sales advanced 17% on a constant currency basis, reflecting strong performance across markets, particularly in Korea, where we continue to see momentum.

signals.speaker: Michel Khalaf
signals.sentence: And Japan countered a solid year-ago sales quarter for life and annuities with almost 90% A&H growth on a constant currency basis following a newly launched medical product.

signals.speaker: Michel Khalaf
signals.sentence: And with favorable demographics, deep distribution and continued product innovation, we see meaningful opportunities ahead.

signals.speaker: Michel Khalaf
signals.sentence: In Latin America, adjusted earnings of $268 million represented a quarterly record and an increase of 15% and 4% on a constant currency basis.

signals.speaker: Michel Khalaf
signals.sentence: Adjusted PFOs increased 6% on a constant currency basis, reflecting robust growth and solid persistency across the region.

signals.speaker: Michel Khalaf
signals.sentence: Latin America continues to demonstrate the value of our leading market positions, multipronged distribution and ability to serve a growing need for protection, health and retirement solutions.

signals.speaker: Michel Khalaf
signals.sentence: Adjusted earnings of $108 million increased 8% or 11% on a constant currency basis.

signals.speaker: Michel Khalaf
signals.sentence: Adjusted PFOs grew 12% on a constant currency basis, supported by sales and renewal activity across the region.

signals.speaker: Michel Khalaf
signals.sentence: Sales increased 15%, reflecting sustained and broad-based growth.

signals.speaker: Michel Khalaf
signals.sentence: The segment generated adjusted earnings of $57 million, up 6%.

signals.speaker: Michel Khalaf
signals.sentence: Growth reflected the contribution from integrating PineBridge Investments and expense management.

signals.speaker: Michel Khalaf
signals.sentence: Our second quarter performance illustrates the advantage of diversification.

signals.speaker: Michel Khalaf
signals.sentence: During the quarter, we repurchased approximately $700 million of common shares.

signals.speaker: Michel Khalaf
signals.sentence: Year-to-date through July, we have returned over $2.4 billion to MetLife shareholders through a combination of stock buybacks and common dividends.

signals.speaker: Michel Khalaf
signals.sentence: Last night, we announced a new $3 billion share repurchase authorization, reflecting our confidence in MetLife's capital generation and long-term outlook.

signals.speaker: Michel Khalaf
signals.sentence: Our approach to capital deployment and allocation remains consistent.

signals.speaker: Michel Khalaf
signals.sentence: Our first priority is to fund responsible organic growth where MetLife has structural advantages and opportunities to earn attractive risk-adjusted returns.

signals.speaker: Michel Khalaf
signals.sentence: We will pursue inorganic investments when they add strategic capabilities, meet our financial criteria and create value.

signals.speaker: Michel Khalaf
signals.sentence: Disciplined strategic capital deployment fuels future earnings and strong recurring free cash flow enables us to invest in our businesses and also return capital consistently.

signals.speaker: Michel Khalaf
signals.sentence: In closing, this was an excellent quarter that once again demonstrated the investment case for MetLife under New Frontier.

signals.speaker: Michel Khalaf
signals.sentence: They create a more balanced and durable earnings profile, along with a stronger foundation for long-term value creation.

signals.speaker: Michel Khalaf
signals.sentence: We are pleased with our progress.

signals.speaker: Michel Khalaf
signals.sentence: We have confidence in the strengths we have built over time, the momentum across our businesses and our ability to execute through a range of environments.

signals.speaker: John McCallion
signals.sentence: This quarter is another strong demonstration of MetLife's earnings power and the strength of our business model.

signals.speaker: John McCallion
signals.sentence: We generated broad-based growth across the enterprise, delivered excellent underwriting results, maintained disciplined expense management and continue to deploy capital prudently.

signals.speaker: John McCallion
signals.sentence: It was an excellent quarter, and the combination of growth, returns and execution enabled us to meet or exceed our key financial commitments once again.

signals.speaker: John McCallion
signals.sentence: Adjusted EPS grew 20%, while adjusted ROE reached 17% at the top end of our 15% to 17% target range.

signals.speaker: John McCallion
signals.sentence: The difference between net income and adjusted earnings was primarily driven by mark-to-market accounting on our derivatives and net investment losses.

signals.speaker: John McCallion
signals.sentence: Adjusted earnings increased 15% year-over-year or 14% on a constant currency basis.

signals.speaker: John McCallion
signals.sentence: Growth was balanced across the enterprise, driven by favorable underwriting margins, strong volume growth across all segments and higher investment margins, partially offset by less favorable expense margins.

signals.speaker: John McCallion
signals.sentence: Adjusted earnings per share were up 20% and 19% on a constant currency basis, with strong earnings growth supported by disciplined capital management.

signals.speaker: John McCallion
signals.sentence: Group Benefits had an outstanding quarter, generating adjusted earnings of $503 million, up 25% year-over-year, driven by favorable underwriting margins and volume growth.

signals.speaker: John McCallion
signals.sentence: Growth remains healthy across the franchise.

signals.speaker: John McCallion
signals.sentence: Sales were up 9% year-to-date and adjusted PFOs increased 1% and up 4%, excluding participating contracts, reflecting growth in both national accounts and regional business.

signals.speaker: John McCallion
signals.sentence: Adjusted earnings were $377 million, up 2% year-over-year, driven by favorable recurring interest margins and volume growth, partially offset by lower variable investment income.

signals.speaker: John McCallion
signals.sentence: Total investment spread was 97 basis points in the second quarter, below our guidance range of 100 to 120 basis points, driven by weaker private equity returns within VII.

signals.speaker: John McCallion
signals.sentence: While core spread, excluding VII, was 100 basis points, up 5 basis points sequentially, reflecting the benefit of asset deployment along with improved real estate equity income.

signals.speaker: John McCallion
signals.sentence: RIS adjusted PFOs, excluding pension risk transfers, were up 19%, driven by strong growth in U.K. longevity reinsurance and structured settlements.

signals.speaker: John McCallion
signals.sentence: Retained liability exposures grew 3% year-over-year at the low end of our 2026 outlook range, consistent with our expectation that growth would build over the year.

signals.speaker: John McCallion
signals.sentence: Asia adjusted earnings were $420 million, up 21% and 25% on a constant currency basis.

signals.speaker: John McCallion
signals.sentence: Results reflect strength across the business, supported by favorable equity markets, higher variable investment income and continued volume growth.

signals.speaker: John McCallion
signals.sentence: Asia's key top line growth metrics continued their strong momentum in Q2.

signals.speaker: John McCallion
signals.sentence: Sales rose 17% on a constant currency basis, fueled by equity market tailwinds in Korea plus traction from recent product launches.

signals.speaker: John McCallion
signals.sentence: In Japan, sales increased 2% year-over-year against a strong prior year comparison and 13% sequentially.

signals.speaker: John McCallion
signals.sentence: Taken together, these results reinforce our confidence in Asia's long-term growth trajectory and the strength of our franchise across the region.

signals.speaker: John McCallion
signals.sentence: Latin America delivered adjusted earnings of $268 million, up 15% year-over-year or 4% on a constant currency basis.

signals.speaker: John McCallion
signals.sentence: Results were driven by strong volume growth as well as favorable market factors, including an elevated encaje return of 5.6% in the second quarter and lower taxes.

signals.speaker: John McCallion
signals.sentence: Top line momentum remained strong with sales up 9% on a constant currency basis and adjusted PFOs up 16% or 6% on a constant currency basis.

signals.speaker: John McCallion
signals.sentence: And we continue to see attractive growth opportunities across the region, supported by strong distribution capabilities, favorable product demand and the increasing reach of our MetLife Accelerator platform.

signals.speaker: John McCallion
signals.sentence: EMEA delivered adjusted earnings of $108 million, up 8% year-over-year or 11% on a constant currency basis.

signals.speaker: John McCallion
signals.sentence: Results were driven by strong volume growth, partially offset by higher expenses in the quarter.

signals.speaker: John McCallion
signals.sentence: EMEA's top line remained strong with adjusted PFOs up 12%, supported by ongoing sales momentum and solid renewal activity across the region.

signals.speaker: John McCallion
signals.sentence: Sales increased 15% on a constant currency basis, reflecting broad gains across markets and geographies.

signals.speaker: John McCallion
signals.sentence: Adjusted earnings were $57 million, up 6%, driven by solid business growth and expense management.

signals.speaker: John McCallion
signals.sentence: Momentum is building across the platform.

signals.speaker: John McCallion
signals.sentence: And as integration benefits continue to emerge, we expect adjusted earnings to maintain their upward trajectory through the second half of the year.

signals.speaker: John McCallion
signals.sentence: This growth, combined with a 410 basis point improvement in operating margin during the quarter, positions MIM to deliver full year adjusted earnings within its guidance range of $240 million to $280 million, though likely toward the low end.

signals.speaker: John McCallion
signals.sentence: We remain confident in the sustained success of this business and our 2027 guidance remains intact.

signals.speaker: John McCallion
signals.sentence: And the company's effective tax rate on adjusted earnings in the quarter was 23%, below our 2026 guidance range of 24% to 26%.

signals.speaker: John McCallion
signals.sentence: Pretax variable investment income was $231 million in the second quarter of 2026.

signals.speaker: John McCallion
signals.sentence: Looking ahead, we expect stronger private equity returns in the third quarter, particularly from our venture capital investments, supported by elevated IPO activity and higher public market valuations.

signals.speaker: John McCallion
signals.sentence: While VII can vary from quarter-to-quarter, we manage the business for normalized returns over time and remain comfortable with our full year outlook.

signals.speaker: John McCallion
signals.sentence: Strong PFO growth and continued expense discipline enabled us to absorb the previously disclosed roughly 50 basis point impact from the PineBridge acquisition.

signals.speaker: John McCallion
signals.sentence: We manage expenses on a full year basis and we remain confident in our ability to beat our 2026 target of 12.1%.

signals.speaker: John McCallion
signals.sentence: Our consistent execution continues to be a MetLife differentiator, reinforcing the durability of our earnings and our ability to invest in growth, while delivering on our financial commitments.

signals.speaker: John McCallion
signals.sentence: In the second quarter, we returned approximately $1.1 billion to shareholders, including approximately $700 million of share repurchases.

signals.speaker: John McCallion
signals.sentence: We also repurchased approximately $225 million of additional shares in July.

signals.speaker: John McCallion
signals.sentence: These actions underscore the confidence in MetLife's earnings power, the strength of our balance sheet and our ability to generate durable free cash flow over time.

signals.speaker: John McCallion
signals.sentence: While results will vary year-to-year, we are comfortable managing ESR anywhere within this range.

signals.speaker: John McCallion
signals.sentence: We generated strong and broad-based growth, produced attractive returns, maintained disciplined expense management and continued to deploy capital from a position of strength.

signals.speaker: Michel Khalaf
signals.sentence: So first, what I will say is that nothing has really changed for us in terms of our M&A philosophy and approach.

signals.speaker: Michel Khalaf
signals.sentence: We've always viewed M&A as a strategic capability.

signals.speaker: Michel Khalaf
signals.sentence: And to your direct question, I've talked in the past about two areas where potentially, we would be likely to consider M&A. And those are asset management and group.

signals.speaker: Michel Khalaf
signals.sentence: We've invested heavily, as you know, in technology as well, and that's really helping us further drive our competitive advantage.

signals.speaker: Michel Khalaf
signals.sentence: So we're always open to considering new capabilities or solutions if that makes sense.

signals.speaker: Michel Khalaf
signals.sentence: The more likely area I would say is asset management, and you saw us do the PineBridge Investments deal late last year.

signals.speaker: Michel Khalaf
signals.sentence: We have a good path to growing organically this business, but we would be open to complementing that with inorganic complementary opportunities.

signals.speaker: Michel Khalaf
signals.sentence: I would also point out that we have a history of being very disciplined with capital deployment and M&A. And we have a high bar to clear to ensure that we create long-term value for our shareholders.

signals.speaker: Ramy Tadros
signals.sentence: We're coming off a record year in 2025.

signals.speaker: Ramy Tadros
signals.sentence: We're going to always be disciplined in terms of how we price this business and focus on generating attractive risk-adjusted returns.

signals.speaker: Ramy Tadros
signals.sentence: So net-net, if you look at all of RIS, we're pretty confident that we're going to be within our retained balance growth of 3% to 5% for the full year, reflecting the strength of the franchise and the product portfolio that we have.

signals.speaker: Lyndon Oliver
signals.sentence: We're really pleased with the sales performance that we've seen all across Asia, not just in Japan.

signals.speaker: Lyndon Oliver
signals.sentence: If we look at the second quarter, sales were up 17%.

signals.speaker: Lyndon Oliver
signals.sentence: Year-to-date, sales are up 19% year-over-year.

signals.speaker: Lyndon Oliver
signals.sentence: What's driving it is we've seen sustained momentum this year, a payoff from a lot of actions we've taken.

signals.speaker: Lyndon Oliver
signals.sentence: We have product innovation, strong product development, both in U.S. dollar as well as local currency products.

signals.speaker: Lyndon Oliver
signals.sentence: But our sales through June have been strong.

signals.speaker: Lyndon Oliver
signals.sentence: And into July, that momentum is continuing.

signals.speaker: Michel Khalaf
signals.sentence: Nothing has changed in terms of how we think about M&A here.

signals.speaker: Michel Khalaf
signals.sentence: But I would emphasize that we are very disciplined when it comes to M&A. We have a high bar to clear here, and we compare M&A to other potential uses of capital as well.

signals.speaker: Michel Khalaf
signals.sentence: With regards to Latin America, I would add that we're really pleased with our business in Latin America.

signals.speaker: Michel Khalaf
signals.sentence: You can see from our results that Latin America is very much on a path to generate $1 billion in earnings this year, which is roughly double from pre-pandemic levels, and this is being fueled by sustained growth there.

signals.speaker: Michel Khalaf
signals.sentence: Our business in Brazil has been the fastest-growing life insurer in that market for several years and is now contributing about 20% of overall Latin America sales.

signals.speaker: Michel Khalaf
signals.sentence: So really pleased with the momentum there as well.

signals.speaker: John McCallion
signals.sentence: When we have the opportunity to reinvest, we leverage the collective power of all our differentiated investment capabilities.

signals.speaker: John McCallion
signals.sentence: But over time, higher rates do provide positive momentum.

signals.speaker: John McCallion
signals.sentence: Given we're in a relatively higher rate environment than several years ago, over time we would probably see a slightly lower allocation to private equity, albeit we're still investing.

signals.speaker: John McCallion
signals.sentence: So directionally, the trend is a modest decline over time on private equity allocation, but that doesn't mean we won't continue to invest in the space.

signals.speaker: Ramy Tadros
signals.sentence: The headline for group from a top line perspective is we're seeing really good momentum.

signals.speaker: Ramy Tadros
signals.sentence: We continue to see rising participation rates within the employee population and continued double-digit growth in the voluntary suite of products.

signals.speaker: Ramy Tadros
signals.sentence: We're pleased with the growth, and we're pleased to be in the range.

signals.speaker: Ramy Tadros
signals.sentence: We see very good momentum going forward across all markets in this business.

signals.speaker: Ramy Tadros
signals.sentence: PFML products have a claim pattern where you have higher upfront claims that tend to normalize after a few months of introduction.

signals.speaker: Ramy Tadros
signals.sentence: This is intentional given the investments we're making in the business, investments in data analytics and AI that are driving improved recoveries, which is giving us positive results this quarter.

signals.speaker: Lyndon Oliver
signals.sentence: We also sell FAS 60 type business as well, and that has been a growing part of our business.

signals.speaker: Lyndon Oliver
signals.sentence: So we'll continue to see PFOs grow, but really the bulk of our business continues to be AUM focused.

signals.speaker: John McCallion
signals.sentence: We knew asset deployment would occur and we saw a bit of improved real estate equity income in the quarter that is likely to seasonally reverse in the third quarter.
